bio.name: Ricardo Giro
bio.summary: Systems & .NET engineer focused on reproducible Linux, Terraform IaC, Docker, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
bio.pitch: Self-hosted 4-app feature flag & runtime configuration platform.
bio.stack: C# / .NET · Linux · Terraform · AWS & Azure · Docker · PostgreSQL · GitHub Actions · Bash & PowerShell

hero.headline: Ricardo Giro — Infrastructure, DevOps & .NET
hero.activeProjectText: — self-hosted 4-app feature flag & runtime config platform.

fm1_1.task: Milestone 1: Start Flaggo 4-app stack: Control Plane Frontend, Control Plane API, Data Plane evaluator, and local PostgreSQL.

fm1_2.task: Milestone 1: Publish only the gateway port; keep internal Data Plane worker and database private.

fm1_3.task: Milestone 1: Verify feature flag creation, rollout updates, kill-switch toggles, and Data Plane evaluations.

fm1_4.task: Milestone 1: Configure health checks, persistent database volumes, restart policies, and structured logs.

fm1_5.task: Milestone 1: Resolve scaffold dependency or service-discovery problems via clean Git commits.

fm2_1.task: Milestone 2: One VPC, two Availability Zones, public and private subnets, routing, and least-privilege Security Groups.

fm2_2.task: Milestone 2: One Linux EC2 instance and one Application Load Balancer (ALB) with health checks.

fm2_3.task: Milestone 2: One private Single-AZ RDS PostgreSQL instance (not publicly accessible).

fm2_4.task: Milestone 2: IAM permissions for instance/secret access; S3-backed Terraform state with locking.

fm2_5.task: Milestone 2: Restrict ALB ingress to designated test IPs; block direct internet access to internal services.

fm3_1.task: Milestone 3: POST /flags — create and update feature flag rules, rollout percentages, and kill switches.

fm3_2.task: Milestone 3: POST /evaluate — evaluate rules dynamically in memory with zero restarts.

fm3_4.task: Milestone 3: Enforce strict environment isolation across projects.

fm4_1.task: Milestone 4: Run application tests, dependency checks, and Terraform validation.

fm4_2.task: Milestone 4: Build versioned Flaggo Docker images and publish to registry.

fm4_3.task: Milestone 4: Document deployment and zero-downtime rollback process.

fm4_4.task: Milestone 4: Write Bash and PowerShell diagnostic scripts collecting service and HTTP health status.

fm5_1.task: Milestone 5: Incident 1 (Networking): Diagnose, fix with minimal change, and document prevention.

fm5_2.task: Milestone 5: Incident 2 (Service Discovery): Test hypothesis with evidence, fix, and document.

fm5_3.task: Milestone 5: Incident 3 (App Correctness): Diagnose rollout/isolation bug, fix, and verify.

fm5_4.task: Milestone 5: Bonus — Azure Portability: Equivalent VNet, NSGs, App Gateway, and Flexible Server spec.

fg_m1.gate: Milestone 1 Gate: All Flaggo services respond, pass local integration tests, and recreate cleanly via Docker Compose.

fg_m2.gate: Milestone 2 Gate: Terraform provisions the stack reproducibly, ALB reports healthy targets, and EC2 reaches RDS privately.

fg_m3.gate: Milestone 3 Gate: Rule creation, dynamic evaluation, percentage bucketing, kill switches, persistence, and isolation work.

fg_m4.gate: Milestone 4 Gate: A second engineer can deploy a tested Flaggo revision without manual reconstruction.

fg_m5.gate: Milestone 5 Gate: Document all three incident recoveries and complete a verified teardown of billable AWS resources.

del_1.name: Git Repository — App code, Terraform, 4-app Docker Compose, and CI.

del_2.name: Architecture Diagram — Subnets, routing, Security Groups, and service topology.

del_3.name: README.md — Reproducible deployment guide from clean checkout.

del_4.name: RUNBOOK.md — Monitoring, restart, kill-switch rollback, and teardown.

del_5.name: INCIDENTS.md — Timestamped investigations, hypotheses, evidence, and fixes.

del_6.name: COSTS.md — Expected and observed AWS costs.

del_7.name: Walkthrough Recording — End-to-end query flow from ALB to PostgreSQL.

del_8.name: Azure Portability Spec — Reusable vs provider-specific Terraform abstractions.

w0_1.task: Week 0: Confirm weekly study/lab workload and target role requirements

w0_2.task: Week 0: Clean GitHub profile (github.com/xarop-pa-toss) and self-hosted Gitea; pin best existing work

w0_3.task: Week 0: Create public reinvention README & Flaggo 4-app architecture overview

w0_4.task: Week 0: Join cloud infrastructure & DevOps technical communities (Meetup, Discord)

w0_5.task: Week 0: Apply to 15-20 current infrastructure roles (Cohort A)

w1_1.task: Weeks 1-2: Publish linux-incident-lab v0.1 & complete Flaggo Milestone 1 local Docker Compose stack

w1_2.task: Weeks 1-2: Document evidence trail and INCIDENTS.md postmortem

w1_3.task: Weeks 1-2: Post narrow technical question/review request (r/sysadmin, Discord)

w1_4.task: Weeks 1-2: Make one useful outward contribution (reproduce issue/docs)

w3_1.task: Weeks 3-4: Build cloud network environment for Flaggo (public ALB + private DB subnets) and publish notes

w3_2.task: Weeks 3-4: Run public review: ask one narrowly framed cloud/networking question after attempt

w3_3.task: Weeks 3-4: Begin bridge-role cohort applications (Cohort B)

w3_4.task: Weeks 3-4: Run one lateral micro-experiment (IAM/Entra ID or Ansible)

w5_2.task: Weeks 5-6: Variables/outputs used, S3 state locking enabled, no secrets, verified teardown instructions

w5_3.task: Weeks 5-6: Run identity/Graph probe OR infrastructure-automation probe

w5_4.task: Weeks 5-6: Choose specialization branch based on transfer speed + interest + market pull

w7_1.task: Weeks 7-8: Publish flaggo-service-delivery (4-app Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI, Terraform validation)

w7_2.task: Weeks 7-8: Include /health/live & /health/ready probes, flag rollout/kill-switch tests, diagnostic scripts

w7_3.task: Weeks 7-8: Submit at least one useful issue/PR to a tool used in the lab

w7_4.task: Weeks 7-8: Expand rebranded application cohorts if gates passed

w9_1.task: Weeks 9-10: Add Flaggo observability lab (Metrics/logs/alerts, RUNBOOK.md, COSTS.md)

w9_2.task: Weeks 9-10: Resolve Milestone 5 incident tickets (Networking, Dependency, App Correctness) and write INCIDENTS.md

w9_3.task: Weeks 9-10: Answer other people's technical questions where qualified

w11_1.task: Weeks 11-12: Integrate Flaggo capstone: Terraform IaC + 4-App Feature Flag Delivery + Identity + Teardown

w11_2.task: Weeks 11-12: Publish a public Flaggo walkthrough showing complete flow from ALB to PostgreSQL and back

w11_3.task: Weeks 11-12: Rewrite Resume/LinkedIn around the new engineering identity

w11_4.task: Weeks 11-12: Targeted engineering outreach; compare conversion by cohort

g0.gate: Week 0 Gate (Calibrate & Launch): One canonical profile another engineer can understand in <3 minutes.

g1.gate: Weeks 1-2 Gate (Linux/Git Gate): Pass unseen Linux incident test: receive external correction, respond with fix/explanation.

g2.gate: Weeks 3-4 Gate (Cloud Translation Gate): Explain and repair a broken dependency; Flaggo project is reproducible by another person.

g3.gate: Weeks 5-6 Gate (Branch Gate): Recreate Flaggo infra from repo and explicitly choose branch (CloudOps, IAM, or DevOps).

g4.gate: Weeks 7-8 Gate (Clean-Environment Gate): Clean-machine Flaggo deployment plus one broken-pipeline incident repaired independently.

g5.gate: Weeks 9-10 Gate (Observability Gate): Diagnose from telemetry and demonstrate reciprocal community participation.

g6.gate: Weeks 11-12 Gate (Market Gate): Technical + market gate pass: Flaggo project survives scrutiny.
